{{Top|leg}}
'''Krella''' was a subscriber to [[Cynabar's Droid Datalog]]. Krella commented on the entry for the [[MD-5 medical droid]], replying to [[Gunman]]'s comment about how upgrading a MD-5 to operate as a [[Security droid/Legends|security droid]] was a bad idea. Krella believed that it could work, and to not underestimate the element of surprise in such an endeavor.<ref name="CDD">{{JournalCite|13|Cynabar's Droid Datalog (article series)}}</ref>
